segments.text: Welcome back to GitHub Awesome, your daily dose of the hottest open- source repos lighting up GitHub right now. In
this episode of GitHub Trending Today, number eight, we're checking out 22 trending open- source projects that are exploding in popularity. If you love
discovering powerful open source like this, smash that like button and let's jump straight into today's trending repos.
Tonell is a LLM friendly serialization format that can cut your data size by up to 50 to 60% compared to JSON, which
also means dramatically lower LM token costs. And unlike binary formats, Tunnel stays completely human readable. But Tunnel isn't just a format. It's a
full-blown data platform. You get a JSON path style query API, CRUD modification tools, hashing and bree indexes, and
even bit packing for boolean data. It's zero dependencies, built-in pure TypeScript, browser ready at just 10 KB
gzipped. Tiny diffusion, a character level language diffusion model for text generation. It's built as a modified
version of the nanohat GPT implementation. But here's the twist.
Instead of traditional auto reggressive generation, this model uses diffusion techniques to generate text character by
character. The best part, this model is only 10.7 million parameters, which means it's incredibly lightweight, easy
to experiment with, and runs comfortably on a laptop without a GPU supercomput.
You know those multi-line shell commands you copy from docs, blogs, or chatg, and then they don't paste cleanly into your
terminal? Yeah, Trimmy fixes that. Trim is a tiny Mac OS menu bar app with one job. Paste once, run once. It
automatically flattens messy multi-line shell snippets into a clean singleline command that actually runs. There are optional toggles, too, like keeping
intentional blank lines, stripping box drawing characters from fancy prompts.
Next up is an incredibly practical tool for anyone on Windows who needs fast speech to text, especially in lockdown
corporate environments. This is Chirp, a fully local dictation app powered by Parakeet V3 ST. Parakeet 3 delivers
speech recognition accuracy nearly identical to Whisper Large V3. We're talking multilingual 4.1 versus 5.05,
but it runs 17x faster and needs no GPU at all, just your CPU. That means Chirp gives you high-end transcription quality without any of the heavy hardware.
ISOBridge, a complete ISO 8583 parser, builder, and forwarder built in. .NET 6.
If you've ever touched ISO 8583, the decades old format behind POS transactions, ATMs, and bank switches, you know it's a jungle. Every vendor has
its own dialect. The tooling is scattered or proprietary, and debugging messages often feels like reading hieroglyphics.
ISOBridge was built to end that pain.
It's a fully functional bridge that parses ISO 8583 messages in binary, builds ISO messages cleanly from JSON,
and logs every single transaction with full audibility.
Sound Monitor, a noise pollution documentation tool built to record, track, and log excessively loud noises with real evidence you can take to your
city council. The goal is simple. If cars are too loud and you need sleep, this app helps you prove it. Sound
Monitor continuously records audio from any selected microphone, monitors realtime decel levels, and automatically logs spikes when noise passes your
threshold. It even includes low frequency detection, targeting that deep 20 to 200Hz rumble that loud cars and modified exhausts are notorious for.
Stop paying for overpriced email tools you don't even like. Camp just dropped and it might be the cleanest open-source
Mailchimp alternative yet. Camp is a lightweight self-hosted email marketing platform built entirely in Go. No bloat,
no dependency soup. You can send campaigns, manage contacts, segment lists, and track analytics like opens and clicks. All without giving your data
to a third party. Create emails with a reusable template system. Import or organize your audience and hit send.
Hopex MCP server, a model context protocol server that gives AI assistants the ability to run real code inside
isolated cloud containers safely, quickly, and with full control. It executes Python, JavaScript, Bash, and
Go in fully isolated environments complete with pre-installed data science tools like pandas, numpy, and mapplotib.
It can run system commands, manage files, spin up background processes, and handle longrunning tasks, all without touching your local machine.
Herilla CRM, open-source CRM built for organizations that need serious customer engagement and workflow automation without the complexity of heavyweight
commercial systems. You get robust people management with accounts, contacts, and detailed role-based permissions. The sales pipeline includes
leads, opportunities, customizable stages, forecasting tools, and even big deal alerts to notify your team when high-val opportunities pop up.
Next on the list is a tool that makes managing traffic feel effortless, especially if you're tired of wrestling with complex YAML files. This is
Traficker, a visual configuration manager that brings simplicity, safety, and clarity to Trafic setups. Instead of
manually editing routers, services, and middlewares, Treyficker gives you a clean, guided web interface where every field validates your input in real time.
No more indentation mistakes, missing fields, or mysterious config failures.
Next project is a big one for anyone working with model context protocol and hitting token limits or scaling headaches. This is the MCP code
execution server and it tackles one of the biggest pain points in MCP today.
context bloat. If you connect Claude to a bunch of MCP servers, say 10, 20, or even 50, each one brings its own tool
schemas. Add them up, and suddenly you're burning 30,000 tokens per query before you even type your prompt. That's
expensive, slow, and totally unsustainable at scale. This project solves that.
Bring some Kauawaii energy to your terminal with Cly Waifu Tamagotchi. It's a CLI ASKY avatar that lives right in your command line. Dress them up,
encourage them, or just let them hang out in background mode. Customize expressions, clothes, and even colors, all saved in your config so your little
asky buddy remembers you. Navigate like a Vim master with H, J, K, L keys, and interact every 5 seconds without messy
loops. Perfect for coders who want a touch of fun while they grind.
Transform your Minecraft world with Falcraft, the fabric mod that brings AI powered 3D generation and texture remixing straight into your game.
Generate entire 3D structures just by typing a text prompt. Castles, towers, anything you can imagine. Point at a
block and watch AI create new designs with perceptual color matching for human vision accurate results. Textures apply
instantly. No restart needed. And background threads keep your game smooth and lag-free.
Meet Flame Haven File Search. Your documents instantly searchable in just minutes. From zero to production in under 5 minutes. No complex
infrastructure. No cloud required. AI powered semantic search means you can ask natural language questions and get answers linked back to your source
documents. PDFs, DocX, all supported up to 50 megabytes. comes with a Python SDK, REST API, and Swagger UI, plus one
command Docker deployment with persistence.
Enter MFAT check, the tool that reveals which Azure AD resources still issue tokens without MFA enforcement using the
ROC flow. Enter MFAT check runs ROC login attempts across dozens of Microsoft cloud resources, checking whether MFA is actually being enforced.
If a resource hands out a token with no MFA, you'll see it immediately colorcoded as MFA not required. This
tool is for authorized testing only, but if you're securing your organization, enter MFAC check shows you exactly where MFA enforcement is still asleep.
Let's talk about Meridian, a zero config setup for cloud code that makes AI assisted development predictable and reliable. Copy two folders, make a
couple scripts executable, and you're done. Meridian preserves context, enforces project rules, and manages tasks and memory. All behind the scenes.
No commands, no API keys, no workflow changes. Just consistent, deterministic clawed behavior straight from your repo.
It's AI development, but without the surprises.
[Music]
Ever wish reverse engineering was faster, more reliable, and didn't rely on messy gooies? Meet Kernigent, the tool that turns any binary into a
conversation. It creates a portable snapshot of your binary and lets an AI answer your questions with real evidence, functions, strings, cross
references, decompiled code. Run it in Docker, CI pipelines, or on your local machine and get repeatable, auditable
results every time. It works with any LLM, OpenAI, Gemini, you name it.
Shenhen Visa modern TypeScript library for checking Shenhen visa appointment availability across 18 countries. at
giving you embassy contacts, visa requirements, and full document checklists all in one call. The latest version is fast thanks to in-memory
caching, dropping repeated check times from 300 milliseconds to just 0.03 milliseconds.
Plus, track your success rates, response times, and cache efficiency with built-in stats and performance monitoring.
Agent Evolver, the AI that levels up on its own. It's a self-evolving agent system that learns without you having to
teach it. Step one, self-questing. It explores its environment and makes its own tasks. No more manual data set
headaches. Step two, self-navigating. It reuses past experiences to explore smarter and faster. Think of it as AI
memory on steroids. Step three, selfattributing. It figures out which moves actually matter, giving precise credit to every action.
Ever struggled getting your documents ready for AI retrieval? Meet Rag Chunk.
It's a Python CLI that parses and chunks your markdown files so your retrieval augmented generation workflows work
flawlessly. Choose from three chunking strategies: fixed size, sliding window, or paragraph, and see which one gives
the best results. Want to know how well it works? Rag Chunk evaluates recall with test JSON files so you can benchmark like a pro.
Dragable video controls built with React Native. It's a smooth, interactive video UI with a play button you can drag, and
when you move it, the previous and next skip buttons pop out. All powered right on the UI thread for buttery smooth animations. Enjoy physics-based
gestures, springy animations, and a gorgeous glass style iOS inspired interface. Full screen background videos
works on both iOS and Android. Every interaction feels responsive and 60 frames per second crisp.
Ever wish you could snap your files away just like Thanos? Meet Hanos, the CLI tool that perfectly deletes half of your files, balanced, as all things should
be. Random selection ensures exactly half vanish. But don't worry, safety first. Confirm before deletion or do a
dry run to see what would go without actually losing anything. Want to include subfolders? It's got recursive support. Plus, a beautiful colorful CLI
with emojis keeps you entertained while it works.
